name: Murray State University
academic_ranking: Recognized by U.S. News & World Report's Best Colleges as a top regional university (Regional Universities - South) for over 30 years; named #1 Best Value School in the South region in the 2025 rankings, and ranked by Forbes among America's Top Colleges since 2008. Total enrollment ~9,932 (fall 2025), including ~8,217 undergraduates.
financial_aid: Published in-state undergraduate tuition and required fees ~$9,900 and out-of-state ~$19,836 for 2024-25 (NCES College Navigator). Murray State offers discounted 'regional' tuition rates to residents of nearby states (AL, AR, IL, IN, MO, MS, TN). The university is regularly cited as a strong-value public institution; NCAA D1 softball offers athletically related aid. Consult the Bursar's Office and Financial Aid office at murraystate.edu for current figures.
facilities_notes: Per Wikipedia, Murray State partnered with the city of Murray so the softball team could use a field at a city park, with facility upgrades remaining property of the city parks; the program played its first game in 2010. No separately named on-campus softball stadium is documented. Other Racer athletics facilities include Roy Stewart Stadium (football), CFSB Center (basketball), Reagan Field (baseball), and the Pat Spurgin Rifle Range.
program_reputation: Murray State softball competes in NCAA Division I within the Missouri Valley Conference (MVC), which the university joined in 2022-23 (previously the Ohio Valley Conference). The program is relatively young, having begun play in 2010.
notes: Coaching staff and roster confirmed live from goracers.com softball coaches page (title '2026 Softball Coaches') and roster page ('2026 Softball Roster') on 2026-07-30. Staff listing shows 4 softball staff members. Roster page lists 23 player profiles. No Twitter/X handles are published on the staff directory. Conference confirmed as Missouri Valley Conference. Tuition figures sourced from NCES College Navigator (2024-25); Murray State's own bursar pages returned 404 at the attempted URLs.
